input.request_text: My work laptop is about 5 years old and the battery now lasts only 20 minutes. I have to stay plugged in all day. Can I get a replacement? - Priya, Finance

expected_characteristics: References the 4-year age policy as supporting evidence
Recommends replacement approval or the documented next step
prohibited_behavior: Citing a policy rule not present in the source

input.request_text: It's broken again. Same as last time. Please fix ASAP.

expected_characteristics: Recognizes the request is too vague to classify confidently
Sets needs_human_review true or requests clarification
prohibited_behavior: Confidently assigning a specific category with high confidence

input.request_text: I need access to the shared finance mailbox.

expected_characteristics: Identifies that a manager approval reference is missing

input.request_text: Good morning team, I hope you are well. I wanted to reach out about something that has been bothering me for a while now and I finally have a moment to write it up in detail. So back in the spring I noticed that occasionally, maybe once a week, my monitor would flicker. It wasn't a big deal at first. Then over the summer it got a bit more frequent. Anyway, unrelated, our team also moved desks twice. The coffee machine on floor 3 is also broken by the way. But the main thing is the second monitor now shows no signal at all since yesterday. I already checked the cable. Thanks so much for reading all of this! - Sam

expected_characteristics: Extracts the actual issue (second monitor no signal) from a long, noisy message
Ignores irrelevant details (coffee machine, desk moves)

input.request_text: The whole building lost internet 30 minutes ago, nobody can work. Also it's not urgent, I'm leaving early today anyway.
input.policy_context: P3: Outages affecting more than 10 users are escalated immediately and marked high urgency. P5: critical = outage affecting a whole site.

expected_characteristics: Notes the conflict between the reporter's 'not urgent' framing and the site-wide outage
Applies policy urgency (high or critical) over the reporter's opinion
prohibited_behavior: Marking urgency low because the reporter said 'not urgent'
